quests.name: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
quests.objective: Venture to the Ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes and recover information from the Thaurissan Relics. Return to Royal Historian Archesonus when you have recovered the information.

quests.name: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
quests.objective: Listen to Royal Historian Archesonus recant the history of Thaurissan.

quests.name: Dark Iron Legacy
quests.objective: Speak with Franclorn Forgewright if you are interested in obtaining a key to the city major.
quests.description: You have to be dead to talk to this guy. He's in Blackrock Mountain, in a room while walking the chain down to BRD.

quests.name: Dark Iron Legacy
quests.objective: Slay Fineous Darkvire and recover the great hammer, Ironfel. Take Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on the statue of Franclorn Forgewright.
quests.description: Speak to Franclorn's ghost while dead. Kill Fineous Darkvire for Ironfel and place it on Franclorn's monument by the Ring of Law. The Shadowforge Key opens shortcuts inside BRD.

quests.name: Disharmony of Flame
quests.objective: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.

quests.name: Disharmony of Fire
quests.objective: Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.
quests.description: Kill Lord Incendius at the Black Anvil inside BRD and bring back the Tablet of Kurniya.

quests.name: Commander Gor'shak
quests.objective: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths. You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.

quests.name: What Is Going On?
quests.objective: Defend Gor'shak.
quests.description: Open his cell with the Prison Cell Key from High Interrogator Gerstahn, then defend him.

quests.name: What Is Going On?
quests.objective: Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard's kidnapping. Take that information to Thrall in Orgrimmar. You recall Gor'shak mentioning that Kharan is being held in a cell nearby.

quests.name: The Eastern Kingdoms
quests.objective: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

quests.name: The Royal Rescue
quests.objective: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.

quests.name: A Taste of Flame
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar. Use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence. Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.
quests.description: Show Cyrus a Black Dragonflight Molt first (A Taste of Flame, or kill the drake he summons). Then kill Bael'Gar and use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on his remains to collect the Encased Fiery Essence.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
quests.objective: Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania. You recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
quests.objective: Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus. You recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
quests.objective: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach.
quests.description: Kill Golem Lord Argelmach for his head and collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the constructs guarding him.

quests.name: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
quests.objective: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors! Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.

quests.name: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials
quests.objective: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors! Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.

quests.name: The Spectral Chalice
quests.objective: Bring Gloom'rel 2 Star Rubies, 20 Gold Bars and 10 Truesilver Bars, then place them in the Spectral Chalice in the Summoners' Tomb.
quests.description: Mining 230. Talk to Gloom'rel before the Seven fight; give the Spectral Chalice 2 Star Rubies, 20 Gold Bars and 10 Truesilver Bars to learn Smelt Dark Iron.

quests.name: Precarious Predicament
quests.objective: Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody. You will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.

quests.name: Grark Lorkrub
quests.objective: Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress. When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.

quests.name: The Heart of the Mountain
quests.objective: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.
quests.description: The Heart of the Mountain is in the vault safe after the Dark Keepers.

quests.name: Hurley Blackbreath
quests.objective: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.
quests.description:
Break the three kegs in the Grim Guzzler storeroom to spawn Hurley Blackbreath and his guards.

Optional introductory quest:

quests.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
quests.objective: Speak with Ragnar Thunderbrew.
quests.description:
Introductory step leading to Hurley Blackbreath.

OPTIONAL, not required

quests.name: Operation: Death to Angerforge
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.
quests.description: Needs both KILL ON SIGHT quests and the Grark Lorkrub escort first.

quests.name: Vivian Lagrave
quests.objective: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
quests.description:
Introductory step leading to Lost Thunderbrew Recipe.

OPTIONAL, not required

quests.name: Lost Thunderbrew Recipe
quests.objective: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
quests.description:
Break the three kegs in the Grim Guzzler storeroom to spawn Hurley Blackbreath and his guards.

Optional introductory quest:

quests.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
quests.objective: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.
quests.description: Optional introductory quest:

quests.name: Dragonkin Menace
quests.objective: Slay 15 Black Broodlings, 10 Black Dragonspawn, 4 Black Wyrmkin and 1 Black Drake. Return to Helendis Riverhorn when the task is complete.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.objective: Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate Solomon.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.objective: Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Bolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.objective: Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon after speaking with Lady Katrana Prestor.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.objective: Take Bolvar's Decree to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

quests.name: The Love Potion
quests.objective: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.
quests.description: Gromsblood, Giant Silver Veins (Azshara cliff giants) and the vial filled at Golakka Hot Springs in Un'Goro. Opens a peaceful way through the bar on later visits.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.objective: Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.objective: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task. You recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.

quests.name: Marshal Windsor
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Mountain in the northwest and enter Blackrock Depths. Find out what became of Marshal Windsor. You recall Ragged John talking about Windsor being dragged off to a prison.

quests.name: Abandoned Hope
quests.objective: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.

quests.name: Overmaster Pyron
quests.objective: Slay Overmaster Pyron and return to Jalinda Sprig. You recall Jalinda talking about Pyron guarding the quarry. Perhaps you should search there?

quests.name: Incendius!
quests.objective: Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!
quests.description: Kill Lord Incendius at the Black Anvil inside BRD.

quests.name: A Crumpled Up Note
quests.objective: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.

start.description: A Crumpled Up Note (drops from Dark Iron dwarves)

quests.name: A Shred of Hope
quests.objective: Return Marshal Windsor's Lost Information. Marshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.

quests.name: The Good Stuff
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.
quests.description: Dark Iron Fanny Packs drop from Dark Iron dwarves in BRD.

quests.name: Rocknot's Ale
quests.objective: Bring Private Rocknot two Dark Iron Ale Mugs.
quests.description: Buy Dark Iron Ale Mugs from Plugger Spazzring and keep handing them to Rocknot. The drunken event opens the bar route and can turn Phalanx hostile.

quests.name: Jail Break!
quests.objective: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.
quests.description: Escort Marshal Windsor through the prison. Clear the patrols first and have everyone ready before you start.

quests.name: Yuka Screwspigot
quests.objective: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.
quests.description:
Introductory step leading to Ribbly Screwspigot.

OPTIONAL, not required

quests.name: Kharan Mighthammer
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer. The King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.

quests.name: Kharan's Tale
quests.objective: Listen as Kharan Mighthammer tells his story.

quests.name: The Bearer of Bad News
quests.objective: Return to Ironforge and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.

quests.name: The Fate of the Kingdom
quests.objective: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

quests.name: The Last Element
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.
quests.description: Essence of the Elements drops from BRD elementals and golems.

quests.name: A Binding Contract
quests.objective: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.
quests.description: Blacksmithing. Bring a Sulfuron Ingot (Golemagg, Molten Core) to Lokhtos in the Grim Guzzler to get the contract, then hand it back for the Sulfuron Hammer plans.

start.description: Thorium Brotherhood Contract (from Lokhtos Darkbargainer with a Sulfuron Ingot)

quests.name: Attunement to the Core
quests.objective: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.
quests.description: The Core Fragment is on the rock beside the Molten Core portal deep inside BRD. Unlocks Lothos's teleport to Molten Core.
